title: Sapporo stays, IHG rewards and what’s next in premium travel
dek: Hotel openings, a major card launch and airline plans worth catching up on.

stories.title: A new base for exploring Hokkaido
stories.summary: Hyatt Centric Sapporo opened on October 3, becoming the brand's first hotel in Hokkaido. Its 216 rooms and suites sit near Odori Park and the former Hokkaido Government Office Building; JR Sapporo Station is about a ten-minute walk away. For travelers planning time in northern Japan, the opening adds a centrally located Hyatt option. Award pricing and availability still need checking for your dates.

stories.title: Chase launches IHG Premier Select with a 200,000-point welcome offer
stories.summary: The IHG One Rewards Premier Select card has a $350 annual fee. Its launch offer awards 200,000 points after $5,000 in purchases within the first three months of account opening; Chase says the launch offers run through November 18. Benefits include an anniversary free night capped at 60,000 points, with the option to add your own points, and 20 annual elite-night credits. Existing IHG cardholders should read their individual notices: benefit effective dates vary, and annual-fee adjustments are scheduled for 2027. Check the issuer's eligibility and offer terms before applying.

stories.title: Hyatt’s luxury expansion puts Mexico in focus
stories.summary: Hyatt expects Park Hyatt Riviera Maya to open by the end of 2026 as its first all-inclusive Park Hyatt. Park Hyatt Mexico City Polanco is expected in spring 2027. Separately, Impression Isla Mujeres is scheduled to join The Unbound Collection by Hyatt on November 2. These are upcoming openings and a collection transition; they do not establish award availability or new booking discounts.

stories.title: Alaska and Hawaiian outline their next premium cabins
stories.summary:
Alaska's Aurora and Hawaiian's Leihōkū plans include upgraded lie-flat suites, while Premium Reserve introduces another premium-economy option on specified aircraft beginning in 2028. The announcement describes future changes, rather than a cabin available across today's flights. Aircraft and rollout timing will matter when comparing tickets. .
